about_the_game:
AYBABTU ( All Your Base Are Belong To us )

Aliens are attacking the White House! Go get 'em!

This is a fun and challenging RETRO "Shoot 'Em Up" style game

In a cataclysmic dawn over Washington D.C., a vast armada of alien spaceships descended upon the White House, unleashing chaos from the skies. Sleek, needle-like scouts darted like hornets, firing precision plasma bolts that melted Secret Service barricades, while colossal saucer dreadnoughts hovered ominously, bombarding the grounds with seismic graviton waves that cracked the earth. Flanking them were biomechanical horrors—writhing tendril ships spewing corrosive mists, and stealthy prism vessels that refracted laser grids into deadly rainbows. As the presidential residence endured the onslaught, humanity's fate hung by a thread against this symphony of interstellar fury.

Don't have time for a long drawn out battle? We've got You covered.

Your main goal is to destroy as much as possible, as fast as possible.

So, if You Speed Run to reach the finish of a quick game,

Your jet will hover around in the End Zone,

and You can take a screenshot of Your High Score to share.

Features:

Several different alien ship types

Many different alien weapons

Collect Power-ups to gain missiles

Automatic Laser Cannons

High Score Counter

High intensity music

Cool RETRO Graphics

CONTROLS:

Arrow Keys to Move

Lasers are auto-fire

[A] to fire missiles

You can also Point & Click Mouse to move

OR

Click and Drag Mouse to move

You can also use a Gamepad / XBOX Controller

DPAD to Move

Lasers are auto-fire

[A] to fire missiles

What is the highest score You can get?

Did You notice any "Easter Eggs"?
